question: 25|Is there any correlation between governance quality and digital readiness score of South Asia?
query: SELECT gov.governance_quality_index, digi.digital_readiness_score FROM (     SELECT country_code, AVG(global_development_indicators.gov_quality) AS governance_quality_index     FROM global_development_indicators     WHERE region = 'South Asia'     GROUP BY country_code ) gov JOIN (     SELECT country_code, AVG(internet_usage_pct) AS digital_readiness_score     FROM global03.global_development_indicators     WHERE region = 'South Asia'     GROUP BY country_code ) digi ON gov.country_code = digi.country_code;  This SQL query calculates the average governance quality index and digital readiness score for South Asian countries, then joins these two averages on their common `country_code`. Note that this does not directly compute a correlation but prepares data sets which can be used to calculate it using statistical software.
